content: Decap CMS (formerly Netlify CMS) is no longer actively maintained by Netlify; community activity has slowed significantly. Sveltia CMS is the recommended modern successor (drop-in config-compatible rewrite, better performance/UI, built-in i18n). Both are Git-based CMS requiring a git-hosted repo + typically Netlify/Vercel-style OAuth backend — awkward fit for a plain-FTP-only host with no git-triggered deploy pipeline unless paired with GitHub Actions FTP deploy.
